# RapidNative

> > RapidNative is an AI-native mobile app builder that generates production-ready React Native code with Expo and NativeWind from natural language prompts.

RapidNative enables product managers, designers, and developers to rapidly prototype and build iOS and Android apps without traditional coding. The platform exports TypeScript code compatible with React Native and Expo, bridging the gap between AI-powered design tools and professional mobile development workflows.

## Key Topics

- React Native
- Expo
- AI-powered code generation
- NativeWind
- Mobile app prototyping
- No-code/low-code development
- TypeScript
- MVP development
- Screen generation from prompts
- Code export
- iOS and Android development
- Rapid prototyping
- Product management workflows
- Team collaboration
- Figma integration
